tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. Ink and muted text read on it (16:1 and 6:1 in light, 16:1 and 8:1 in dark).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, the pace bib, form fields. Ink, muted, river and accent text read on it.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on bg and surface. Also the fill of header bars and the final call-to-action band, with bg as the text colour on it.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and card taglines on bg and surface (6:1 or better in both themes). Also the border of form inputs on the share pages.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders. Decorative only: at 1.3:1 in light it is too faint to mark an input, so use muted for that.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one action colour: primary buttons, the emphasised word in a headline, big figures, the selected tab. Text in it reads on surface (4.6:1 light, 5.8:1 dark) but not on bg in light (4.2:1), so keep small accent text on surface.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (4.6:1 in light, 6.5:1 in dark). Never literal white.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Ground for the accent tag on the main programme card. Accent text on it is 3.8:1 in light, kept from the source and acceptable only for the 12px uppercase tag; do not use it for running text.

tokens.name: river
tokens.usage: Eyebrows, credential chips, big numbers on pace strips, focus rings. Reads on bg, surface and river-tint (5:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: river-tint
tokens.usage: Ground for chips, free-plan tags and count tiles. River text on it is 5:1 in light and 6.6:1 in dark.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: The hero headline. Uppercase. Scales down to 50px on phones. One emphasised word in accent.
styles.sample: Every runner has a next goal

styles.name: card-name
styles.usage: The name on a share card. Uppercase.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: Section headings. Uppercase. Scales down to 34px on phones.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Big numbers on the pace strip and facts bar.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Titles inside programme and format cards. Uppercase.

styles.name: lede
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under the hero headline. Colour muted.
styles.sample: Structured training built around your fitness and goals.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Personalised weekly training plans based on fitness and race goals.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button labels and FAQ questions (19px for the questions).

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Notes under tables and forms. Colour muted.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Section eyebrows and table headers. Uppercase, in river.

styles.name: pace
styles.usage: Paces, links on the share card, anything with tabular digits.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between tabs and small controls.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap inside cards and button rows.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Page side gutter on phones; gap between grid cards.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Gap between programme cards.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Gap under a section heading; share card side padding.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Gap between hero columns.

tokens.name: space-72
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a page section.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Tags and chips.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons and form fields.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Tables, tabs, the facts bar and the WhatsApp tile.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, the pace bib and the share card.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The final call-to-action band.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: The recommended badge.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Round photos.

border.note: The site separates things with borders, not shadows.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Table and card borders, in line.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: The bib, the share card and ghost buttons, in ink; the primary button in accent.

tokens.name: border-photo
tokens.usage: Round photo ring, in ink.

tokens.name: wrap-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the page content.

tokens.name: card-width
tokens.usage: Share card design width. It is exported at 2x, so the saved picture is 1080px wide.

tokens.name: breakpoint-phone
tokens.usage: Facts bar and pace strip stack to one column below this width.

tokens.name: breakpoint-tablet
tokens.usage: Two-column sections stack to one column below this width.
